NEOW.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARL: Hello, Mister Neow! Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?
Ask... and be answered... the answer you seek... lies at the top of the tower...
I've always wondered — why do you keep watching over the adventurers who climb this tower?
Go forth... and find... your answer...
DARV.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARL: Hello, sir! May I interview you? What are you collecting all these treasures in the tower for?
Mah treasures only go to travelers ah take a likin' to! Yer a fine one, little miss — come take somethin' before ya go!
Sir, how long have you lived in the Spire? Has the ecosystem here changed over the years?
All ah know is the treasure ah can scoop up keeps gettin' more plentiful!
PAEL.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARL: This place is truly marvelous — a dragon made of mud that can actually talk.
A dragon of mud... can also... grant you blessings...
OROBAS.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHA: Pink human! From outside the tower! Carrying something shiny?
This is my Kamera! Come on — look into the lens, and no blinking now!
Stories! Did you bring any? Tell! Tell!
I have a copy of The Steambird right here — would you like to read it?
TEZCATARA.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_: Come, child, have a bowl of hot soup and warm yourself up.
Thank you, ma'am! Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?
NONUPEIPE.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_: What a lovely, tasteful outfit. Never before have I seen a young lady so full of life anywhere in the Spire.
Thank you! This was made to order at Chioriya Boutique. If you'd like, I could have one ordered for you too!
Ma'am, how long have you lived in the Spire? Do many people come here to climb it?
I have seen more people than I can count, yet none so radiant as you. Here — put this on, and you will shine even brighter.
TANX.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHARL: W-wait wait wait wait! Please don't do this to an unarmed journalist!
Then take up arms and arm yourself! Go tear your enemies apart!
That clumsy block in your hands hardly counts as a weapon! Let me arm you properly!
This isn't a weapon — it's a Kamera, for taking pictures! Come on, look here!
Why does this little thing give off such a dazzling light?!
VAKUU.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARACTER_CHAR: Welcome, young lady. Everything here is a rare treasure seldom seen outside — come pick one that catches your eye.
These all look a little strange... Sir, would you mind if I took a couple of photos?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS2_CHARLOTTE_CHARAC: Hello, sir! Are you the master of this tower? Might I ask you a few questions?
Polite, but noisy. Return to the bottom.
Whew... I finally made it back up here...
Where do you come from? What do you seek?
There's nothing I want — I just have a few questions, that's all!
